item.title: “Park Chan-dae Is All Talk; I’m a Proven Worker for Incheon” (“박찬대는 말뿐인 말꾼, 난 검증된 인천 일꾼”)
item.description:
“Park Chan-dae Is All Talk; I’m a Proven Worker for Incheon” (“박찬대는 말뿐인 말꾼, 난 검증된 인천 일꾼”)

Yoo Jeong-bok, the People Power Party candidate for Incheon mayor seeking a third term, stated, “I will complete the ‘Incheon International Free Special City,’ expanding the economic free zone beyond Songdo, Yeongjong, and Cheongna to all of Incheon.” Candidate Yoo added, “Incheon has faced government discrimination and neglect simply because it’s part of the capital region,” and vowed to push for the enactment of a Special Act on the Incheon Special City, containing special provisions at the level of a special act on administrative integration of cities and provinces. (3선에 도전하는 국민의힘 유정복 인천시장 후보는 “송도·영종·청라를 넘어 인천 전역을 경제자유구역으로 만드는 ‘인천국제자유특별시’를 완성시키겠다”고 말했다. 유 후보는 “인천은 수도권이란 이유로 정부의 역차별과 홀대를 받았다”면서 시·도 행정통합특별법 수준의 특례 조항이 담긴 인천특별시 특별법 제정을 추진하겠다고 했다.)

Candidate Yoo’s opponent is Park Chan-dae of the Democratic Party of Korea, who has served as a three-term lawmaker in Incheon’s Yeonsu-gu Gap district since 2016. Yoo remarked, “I have no idea what Park, who has been a National Assembly member for over ten years in Incheon, has actually done for the city.” The interview was conducted in two sessions on the 29th of last month and the 5th of this month. (유 후보의 상대는 2016년부터 인천 연수갑에서 3선 의원을 지낸 더불어민주당 박찬대 후보다. 유 후보는 “인천에서 국회의원을 10년 넘게 했다는 박 후보가 실질적으로 인천을 위해 한 일이 무엇인지 전혀 모르겠다”고 했다. 인터뷰는 지난달 29일과 5일 두 차례 걸쳐 이뤄졌다.)

-What is your reason for seeking a third term? (-3선 도전 이유는.)

“Incheon is currently developing into a leading city in South Korea. We’ve achieved objective results: last year’s top national increase in birth rate, top average economic growth rate over the past three years, and top ranking in local government innovation evaluations for four consecutive years. In the ‘Happy City Index’ released by French and British research institutes, Incheon ranked 49th globally this year, sixth in Asia. It’s a crucial time, and we cannot let Incheon regress.” (“인천은 지금 대한민국을 선도하는 도시로 발전하고 있다. 지난해 출생아 수 증가율 전국 1위, 최근 3년 평균 경제성장률 1위, 4년 연속 지방정부 혁신 평가 1위 등 객관적 성과를 냈다. 프랑스·영국 연구 기관이 발표한 ‘행복 도시 지수’에서 올해 인천은 세계 49위로 아시아에서 여섯째다. 중요한 시기인데, 여기서 인천을 후퇴시킬 수 없다.”)

-Please introduce the achievements during your tenure. (-재임 기간 성과를 소개해달라.)

“The ‘1,000 Won Housing’ for newlyweds to live for a daily rent of 1,000 won, the ‘1,000 Won Parcel Service’ reducing logistics costs for small business owners to 1,000 won, the ‘1,000 Won Breakfast’ where the government, local authorities, and universities share the cost of college students’ morning meals, and the ‘1,000 Won Laundry’ washing work clothes for employees at workplaces with fewer than 50 people for 1,000 won—all were successes. Citizens call me ‘the 1,000 Won Mayor.’ I plan to expand tangible welfare policies like the ‘1,000 Won Diaper’ for parents.” (“신혼부부 등이 하루 임차료 1000원을 내고 거주할 수 있는 ‘천원 주택’, 소상공인의 물류비 부담을 1000원으로 낮춘 ‘천원 택배’, 대학생의 아침 식사 비용을 정부·지자체·대학이 분담한 ‘천원 아침밥’, 50인 미만 사업장 근로자의 작업복을 1000원에 세탁해주는 ‘천원 세탁소’까지 모두 성공작이었다. 시민들은 저를 ‘천원 시장(市長)’이라고 부른다. 부모들을 위한 ‘천원 기저귀’ 등 체감형 복지 정책을 더 확대하겠다.")

-What are your plans for Incheon’s development? (-인천 발전을 위한 계획은.)

“The core is completing the Incheon International Free Special City. We need to break down various regulations across the entire city, beyond specific zones like Songdo, Yeongjong, and Cheongna, and enable the application of special provisions such as tax benefits and investment attraction to foster it as a global city. We are preparing the Special Act with lawmakers, which will include provisions to strengthen the authority of the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority, relocate special local administrative agencies, and support hosting international events. A bill to designate and develop the Incheon Airport area as an ‘airport economic zone’ passed the National Assembly last month. Such tasks aren’t completed in a year or two. If the efforts so far are halted, it would be a huge loss for Incheon.” (“핵심은 인천국제자유특별시의 완성이다. 송도·영종·청라 등 특정 구역을 넘어 시 전역에 각종 규제를 혁파하고 세제 혜택, 투자 유치 등 특례 적용이 가능하도록 해 세계적 도시로 육성해야 한다. 국회의원들과 특별법 제정을 준비 중이다. 인천경제자유구역청 권한 강화, 특별지방행정기관 이전, 국제 행사 유치 지원 등의 특례 조항을 담을 생각이다. 인천공항 일대를 ‘공항 경제권’으로 지정 육성하는 법안이 지난달 국회를 통과했다. 이런 일은 한두 해 만에 완성되지 않는다. 그간의 노력이 중단되면 인천에도 매우 큰 손실이다.")

-Democratic Party candidate Park Chan-dae is considered a core member of the pro-Lee Jae-myung faction. (-민주당 박찬대 후보는 친명 핵심으로 분류된다.)

“City administration isn’t done through words, nor can someone else do it for you. It’s true Park is well-known because he’s been in politics with President Lee Jae-myung, but I can’t help but ask what he’s done for Incheon in over ten years as a lawmaker. Unlike Park, who has only been a National Assembly member with no administrative experience, I’ve served as a county head, district head, mayor, minister, and lawmaker. What a mayor needs isn’t words or promises, but experience and results. Whether I’m a proven worker or Park is all talk, the citizens will judge wisely.” (“시정은 말로 하는 것도 아니고 누가 대신 해주는 것도 아니다. 박 후보가 이재명 대통령과 함께 정치를 했기 때문에 인지도가 높은 건 맞지만 인천 국회의원을 10년 넘게 하면서 인천을 위해 한 일이 무엇인지 묻지 않을 수 없다. 국회의원만 해서 행정 경험이 없는 박 후보와 달리 난 군수, 구청장, 시장, 장관, 국회의원을 경험했다. 시장에게 필요한 건 말과 약속이 아니라 경험과 성과다. 검증된 일꾼이냐 말뿐인 말꾼이냐 시민이 현명하게 판단할 것이다.”)

-You strongly oppose the Democratic Party’s push for the ‘fabricated indictment’ special counsel act. (-민주당이 추진하는 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법을 강하게 반대하고 있다.)

“In a word, it’s a ‘self-pardon’ bill where the president directly picks a special counsel to eliminate his own trials. This is unthinkable in a normal democratic country and amounts to a death sentence for the rule of law in South Korea. The president is showing arrogance, intoxicated by approval ratings and ignoring the people. Arrogant power will surely be judged by the citizens. Candidate Park Chan-dae must clarify his stance on the special counsel act.” (“한 마디로 대통령이 자기 재판 없애줄 특검을 직접 뽑는 ‘셀프 면죄부’ 법안이다. 정상적인 민주주의 국가에서 있을 수 없는 일이고 대한민국 법치에 대한 사형 선고다. 대통령이 지지율에 취해 국민을 무시하는 오만함을 드러내고 있는데 오만한 권력은 반드시 국민들이 심판할 것이다. 박찬대 후보는 특검법안에 대한 입장을 밝혀야 한다.”)

-Opposition to the special counsel act is also sparking discussions on opposition alliances. (-특검법 반대를 계기로 야권 연대도 논의되고 있다.)

“To prevent South Korea from becoming a one-party state under the Democratic Party, there’s no disagreement that conservatives must unite as one team. Blocking President Lee’s self-pardon special counsel act is the top priority.” (“대한민국이 민주당 일당(一黨) 국가가 되는 것을 저지하려면 보수가 원팀으로 뭉쳐야 한다는 데 이견이 있을 수 없다. 이 대통령 면죄부 특검법을 막아내는 것이 우선 과제다.”)

-What is the public sentiment in Incheon toward the People Power Party? (-국민의힘에 대한 인천 민심은 어떤가.)

“Citizens feel frustrated, and party members are heavy-hearted. Some citizens say they’re disappointed and worried about the People Power Party and won’t go to the polls, but that would lead to even more worrying outcomes. Whenever I meet such people, I urge them, ‘Have confidence and join us.’ As the election approaches, factors like character and policy over party become more important in judgment, narrowing the gap in poll support between candidates. Amid the national democratic crisis, there will also be a consolidation of conservatives. The harder it is for the party, the more I ask citizens to exercise their voting rights to prevent the nation from going down the wrong path.” (“시민들은 답답해하고 당원들은 무거운 마음이다. 국민의힘에 실망하고 걱정해 투표소에 가지 않겠다고 말하는 시민도 있는데, 그러면 더욱 걱정스러운 일이 벌어질 것이다. 그런 분들을 만날 때마다 ‘자신감을 갖고 함께하자’고 호소하고 있다. 선거가 다가올수록 정당보다 인물·정책이 중요한 판단 요인이 되면서 여야 후보 간 여론조사 지지율 격차가 좁혀지고 있다. 국가적 민주주의 위기 속에서 보수층 결집도 있을 것이다. 당이 어렵고 힘들수록 시민들께서 투표권을 행사해 국가가 잘못된 길로 가는 걸 막아달라.”)

-Some local government heads are openly criticizing People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk. (-일부 단체장은 국민의힘 장동혁 대표를 공개 비판한다.)

“I fully understand their positions, but if we keep showing division externally, we only benefit the enemy. Looking back at past elections, none were won through internal division. There may be hurt feelings, but now is the time to unite to stop the dictatorship of the Lee Jae-myung government. I have things to say, too, but I’m holding back because it could be seen as more misunderstanding. Candidates should compete with policies and visions, and the leadership must humbly accept public sentiment and coldly acknowledge reality. I hope Chairman Jang shows the public the same resolve and desperation he had during the filibuster and hunger strike once the nomination schedule is over.” (“그분들의 입장을 충분히 이해하지만, 우리가 자꾸 분열의 모습을 외부에 보이면 적을 이롭게 하는 것이다. 역대 선거를 돌아봐도 내부 분열해서 이긴 선거가 없다. 서운한 마음이 있겠지만 지금은 이재명 정부의 독재를 막기 위해 단결해야 할 때다. 저도 할 말이 있지만 또 다른 오해로 비칠 수 있기 때문에 자제하고 있다. 후보는 후보대로 정책과 비전으로 승부하면 되고, 지도부는 민심을 겸허히 받아들이고 냉정하게 현실을 인정해야 한다. 장 대표는 공천 일정이 끝나는 대로 필리버스터와 단식 투쟁을 이어 갔던 결기와 처절함을 국민에게 보여주길 바란다.”)

☞Who is Yoo Jeong-bok (☞유정복은 누구)

Born in Incheon, he graduated from Jemulpo High School and Yonsei University’s Department of Political Science and Diplomacy. After passing the civil service exam in 1979, he worked in the Ministry of Home Affairs and elsewhere. He served as the elected mayor of Gimpo, then as a three-term lawmaker, Minister of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs, and Minister of Security and Public Administration. He was elected Incheon mayor in 2014 and re-elected in 2022. (인천 출신으로 제물포고, 연세대 정치외교학과를 졸업했다. 1979년 행정고시에 합격한 이후 내무부 등에서 근무했다. 민선 김포시장을 거쳐 3선 의원, 농림수산식품부 장관, 안전행정부 장관을 지냈다. 2014년 인천시장에 당선됐고 2022년 재선했다.)

item.title: "Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel, Postponed Until After Elections" Democratic Party Aligns with Lee's Directive (“조작기소 특검, 일단 선거 뒤로” 李 주문에 보조 맞추는 민주당)
item.description:
"Fabricated Indictment Special Counsel, Postponed Until After Elections" Democratic Party Aligns with Lee's Directive (“조작기소 특검, 일단 선거 뒤로” 李 주문에 보조 맞추는 민주당)

On the 5th, Representative Jeong Cheong-rae of the Democratic Party of Korea stated regarding the timing and procedure for handling the "fabricated indictment" special counsel bill—which allows for the dismissal of charges in President Lee Jae-myung's case—that "we will gather the consensus of the people, party members, and lawmakers to make the best choice." This is seen as aligning with President Lee Jae-myung's remarks the previous day, who asked for "judgment after a deliberation process" on the timing and procedure for handling the special counsel bill. <<> Representative Jeong, after a campaign rally in Dongducheon, Gyeonggi Province, met with reporters and said, "Since there was a briefing from the presidential office yesterday, the party and the presidential office need to coordinate," adding, "We will gather opinions through a general meeting of lawmakers and also seek the views of party members to determine the best course of action." Following the presidential office's request for "deliberation," the Democratic Party's leadership was reported to have conveyed instructions to the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee to "take a 20-day consideration period and gather input" regarding the special counsel bill. Kim Hyeon-jeong, the party's spokesperson, said on a radio program that day, "As President Lee said, we will decide on the timing of the bill's handling through a deliberation process involving internal party meetings, subcommittees, standing committees, and general meetings of lawmakers." A ruling party official commented, "Specific measures, including the timing of the bill's processing, are expected to be determined by the end of this month when the 20-day consideration period ends." <<> Amid the People Power Party pointing out constitutional violations in the special counsel bill and demanding its immediate withdrawal, voices among the Democratic Party's candidates for the June 3 election have emerged calling for "handling it after the election." Song Young-gil, candidate for the by-election in Incheon's Yeonsu-gu District A, said on a radio program that day, "I wonder if we need to make the special counsel bill an issue during the election," adding, "Calm discussion isn't possible during an election." Lee Kwang-jae, candidate for the by-election in Hanam-gu District A, also stated on a radio program, "We shouldn't overdo it during the election process." (더불어민주당 정청래 대표는 5일 이재명 대통령 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있게 한 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법안 처리 시점과 절차에 대해 “국민·당원·의원 총의를 모아 가장 좋은 선택을 하겠다”고 밝혔다. 전날 이재명 대통령이 특검법 처리 시기와 절차에 대해 “숙의 과정을 거쳐서 판단해 달라”고 하자, 보조를 맞춘 것으로 풀이된다.)

item.title: 7 Opposition Local Government Candidates Gather to Condemn Special Counsel Act (野 단체장 후보 7명, 한자리 모여 특검법 규탄)
item.description:
7 Opposition Local Government Candidates Gather to Condemn Special Counsel Act (野 단체장 후보 7명, 한자리 모여 특검법 규탄)

Candidates from the People Power Party (PPP) for provincial governors and mayors held a joint press conference on the 5th to condemn the "fabricated indictment" special counsel act promoted by the Democratic Party of Korea. The act includes provisions that could allow for the dismissal of charges against President Lee Jae-myung, including cases currently on trial, and the presidential office expressed support for the bill's intent the previous day. In response, the PPP candidates rallied voters by advocating for "defending the constitutional order." (국민의힘 시·도지사 후보들이 5일 더불어민주당이 추진하는 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법을 규탄하는 공동 기자회견을 열었다. 재판 중인 사안을 포함해 이재명 대통령 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있는 내용으로, 청와대도 전날 법안 취지에 찬성하는 입장을 밝혔다. 그러자 국민의힘 후보들은 ‘헌정 수호’를 내세우며 유권자 결집에 나선 것이다.)

Seven PPP candidates—Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon, Gyeonggi Governor candidate Yang Hyang-ja, Incheon Mayor Yoo Jeong-bok, Gangwon Governor Kim Jin-tae, North Chungcheong Governor Kim Young-hwan, North Jeolla Governor candidate Yang Jeong-mu, and Sejong Mayor Choi Min-ho—held an emergency press conference in front of Bosingak Pavilion in Jongno-gu, Seoul, on the same day. They described the "fabricated indictment special counsel act" as "the ultimate destroyer of anti-democratic and anti-constitutional constitutional order." Candidate Oh Se-hoon stated, "The moment the law becomes a shield to erase the crimes of those in power, it is no longer a rule-of-law state but a dictatorship," adding, "We will fight to the end alongside all political parties, civil society, and conscientious citizens who share the cause of defending the constitutional order." (국민의힘 오세훈 서울시장, 양향자 경기지사, 유정복 인천시장, 김진태 강원지사, 김영환 충북지사, 양정무 전북지사, 최민호 세종시장 후보 등 7명은 이날 서울 종로구 보신각 앞에서 긴급 기자회견을 열었다. 이들은 “(조작기소 특검법은) 반민주적·반헌법적 헌정 질서 파괴의 끝판왕”이라고 했다. 오세훈 후보는 “법이 권력자의 죄를 지우는 방패로 전락하는 순간, 더 이상 법치국가가 아닌 독재”라며 “헌정 수호라는 대의에 뜻을 같이 하는 모든 정당, 시민사회, 양심 있는 국민과 함께 끝까지 맞서 싸울 것”이라고 했다.)

The candidates issued a resolution under the name "All PPP Metropolitan Government Candidates" and demanded, "President Lee must clearly declare to the people that there will be no dismissal of charges against me, and that I will face trial according to the law and principles." Party leadership, including Representative Jang Dong-hyuk, did not attend the press conference. (후보들은 ‘국민의힘 광역단체장 후보 일동’ 명의로 결의문을 발표하고 “이 대통령은 ‘나의 혐의에 대한 공소 취소는 결코 없으며 법과 원칙에 따라 재판을 받겠다’는 점을 국민 앞에 분명히 천명하라”고 했다. 이날 기자회견에는 장동혁 대표 등 당 지도부는 참석하지 않았다.)

Daegu Mayor candidate Choo Kyung-ho, North Gyeongsang Governor candidate Lee Cheol-woo, Busan Mayor candidate Park Hyung-joon, Ulsan Mayor candidate Kim Doo-kyum, and South Gyeongsang Governor candidate Park Wan-soo are also scheduled to hold a condemnation press conference in Ulsan on the 6th. This marks the third consecutive day of events denouncing the special counsel act, following a meeting on the 4th where PPP candidates from the metropolitan area jointly held an "emergency joint meeting" with candidates from the Reform Party at the National Assembly to "block judicial insurrection." Candidate Park Hyung-joon posted on Facebook, "A nationwide movement to block Lee Jae-myung's 'crime erasure' special counsel act must arise. I will lead the charge." An opposition source commented, "The push for the special counsel act is uniting opposition candidates and conservative supporters." (추경호 대구시장, 이철우 경북지사, 박형준 부산시장, 김두겸 울산시장, 박완수 경남지사 후보도 6일 울산에서 규탄 기자회견을 열 예정이다. 국민의힘 수도권 후보들이 지난 4일 국회에서 개혁신당 후보들과 함께 ‘사법 내란 저지를 위한 긴급 연석회의’를 개최한 이후 사흘 연속 특검법 규탄 행사를 여는 셈이다. 박형준 후보는 이날 페이스북에서 “이재명 ‘삭죄’ 특검법 저지 범국민 운동이 일어나야 한다. 저부터 앞장 서겠다”고 했다. 야권 관계자는 “특검법 추진이 야권 후보들과 보수 지지층을 하나로 뭉치게 하고 있다”고 했다.)

Representative Jang Dong-hyuk held a press conference at the National Assembly on the same day, describing the push for the "fabricated indictment" special counsel act as "a bizarre idea that even a typical dictator would find hard to conceive" and "a dictator's guidebook that will go down in world history." Floor leader Song Eon-seok posted on Facebook, calling it "a death sentence for the rule of law and an act of violence tolling the death knell for liberal democracy." (장동혁 대표는 이날 국회에서 기자회견을 열고 ‘조작기소’ 특검법 추진에 대해 “어지간한 독재자도 생각하기 어려운 신기한 발상”이라며 “세계사에 길이 남을 독재 가이드북”이라고 했다. 송언석 원내대표는 페이스북에서 “법치주의에 대한 사망 선고이자, 자유민주주의에 조종(弔鐘)을 울리는 폭거”라고 했다.)

item.title: "Sexual harassment? You have a dirty mind" – Democratic Party Research Institute Deputy Director stirs controversy over 'oppa' (“성희롱? 머리에 음란마귀” 오빠 논란 키운 민주硏 부원장)
item.description:
"Sexual harassment? You have a dirty mind" – Democratic Party Research Institute Deputy Director stirs controversy over 'oppa' (“성희롱? 머리에 음란마귀” 오빠 논란 키운 민주硏 부원장)

Amid the controversy surrounding Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae and Busan Buk-gu by-election candidate Ha Jeong-woo, who allegedly asked an elementary school girl to call them "oppa" during a campaign rally, some within the Democratic Party have defended the two, claiming that "'oppa' is a common form of address." Women's groups criticized Chung, stating, "The Democratic Party lacks a gender-sensitive perspective." (더불어민주당 정청래 대표와 하정우 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 후보가 유세 도중 초등학교 여아에게 ‘오빠’ 호칭을 요구했다는 논란과 관련해, 민주당 일각에서 “‘오빠’는 평범한 호칭”이라며 두 사람을 두둔하는 주장이 나왔다. 여성 단체는 “민주당에 성인지적 관점이 없다”고 정 대표를 비판했다.)

Kim Gwang-min, Deputy Director of the Democratic Party Research Institute, wrote on Facebook on the 4th, "I don't know where that amazing imagination comes from that turns a simple 'oppa' into child sexual harassment," adding, "If your own head is full of dirty thoughts, isn't that why even a common term used between a man and a woman with an age difference sounds sexual to you?" His remarks suggest that criticism from the People Power Party accusing Chung and Ha of "child sexual harassment" is excessive. (김광민 민주연구원 부원장은 4일 페이스북 글에서 “‘오빠’ 소리 한 번에 아동 성희롱까지 끌어오는 그 대단한 상상력은 대체 어디서 나오는 건지 모르겠다”며 “본인 머릿속이 온통 음란 마귀로 가득 차 있으니 나이 차이 나는 남녀가 부르는 평범한 호칭조차 섹슈얼하게 들리는 것 아니냐”고 말했다. 국민의힘에서 정 대표와 하 후보가 ‘아동 성희롱’을 했다고 비판한 것은 과도하다는 취지다.)

On the 3rd, during a campaign rally at Busan's Gupo Market, Chung said to a first-grade elementary school girl, "Call me oppa, Jeong-woo oppa." Ha also called himself "oppa." Both later apologized, saying, "We feel sorry for the child and her parents, as she has been hurt by being at the center of the controversy," but the backlash continues. (정 대표는 지난 3일 부산 구포시장 유세 도중 초등학교 1학년 여아에게 “정우 오빠. 오빠 해 봐요”라고 했고, 하 후보도 “오빠”라고 했다. 정 대표와 하 후보는 이후 “아이가 논란의 중심에 서게 돼 상처받으셨을 아이와 아이의 부모님께 송구하다”고 했지만, 논란은 계속되고 있다.)

However, Deputy Director Kim stated, "This isn't feminism; it's just projecting one's own distorted sexual fantasies onto innocent people. It’s the result of ignorance, learning feminism as a 'word censorship game,'" he said. As the controversy grew, Kim deleted the post but added in a follow-up, "Turning 'oppa' into a sexual fantasy is a coercive act of violence that isolates the other person as an 'object' rather than treating them as a person." Kim is currently a Gyeonggi Province council member and served as a lawyer for Lee Hwa-young, former Gyeonggi Province Vice Governor for Peace involved in the 'Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance case.' (그러나 김 부원장은 “이건 페미니즘이 아니라 그냥 본인의 왜곡된 성적 판타지를 애먼 사람한테 투사하는 수준”이라며 “페미니즘을 ‘단어 검열 놀이’로 배운 무식의 소치랄까”라고 했다. 논란이 커지자 김 부원장은 해당 글을 삭제했지만, 추가 글에서도 “‘오빠’를 성적 판타지로 변질시키는 것은 상대를 인격체가 아닌 ‘대상’으로 고립시키는 권력적 폭력”이라고 했다. 김 부원장은 현직 경기도의원이자, ‘쌍방울 대북 송금 사건’의 이화영 전 경기도 평화부지사 변호인이다.)

Amid this, the Korean Women's Association United issued a comment on the 5th, stating, "The remark in a public space asking a future generation and citizen voter to 'call me oppa' clearly reveals a lack of a gender-sensitive perspective," adding, "The Democratic Party must use this incident to clearly recognize its lack of a gender-sensitive perspective and review its internal awareness and practices." The women's association also said, "At the center of the controversy and criticism are not the child, but the ruling party leader and the Democratic Party." (이런 가운데 한국여성단체연합은 5일 논평에서 “공적 공간에서 미래 세대이자 유권자 시민에게 ‘오빠라고 불러보라’고 한 발언은 성인지적 관점이 부재함을 여실히 드러내는 것”이라면서 “이번 사건을 계기로 민주당은 성인지적 관점의 부재를 분명히 인식하고, 당내의 인식과 관행을 점검해야 한다”고 했다. 여성단체연합은 또 “논란과 비판의 중심에 선 것은 아이가 아니라 집권 여당의 당대표와 민주당”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Is It the 'Jang Dong-hyuk Decoupling' Effect?… Oh Se-hoon Narrows the Gap and Gains Ground (‘장동혁 디커플링’ 효과인가… 오세훈, 격차 좁히며 추격)
item.description:
Is It the 'Jang Dong-hyuk Decoupling' Effect?… Oh Se-hoon Narrows the Gap and Gains Ground (‘장동혁 디커플링’ 효과인가… 오세훈, 격차 좁히며 추격)

A poll result has been released showing that the gap in approval ratings between the ruling and opposition candidates for the Seoul mayoral election has narrowed to a single digit. While still outside the margin of error, analysis suggests that Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party (PPP) candidate, is closing the gap with Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate. (서울시장 선거에 출마한 여야 후보의 지지율 격차가 한 자릿수까지 줄었다는 여론조사 결과가 나왔다. 오차 범위 밖이지만, 정원오 민주당 후보와의 격차를 오세훈 국민의힘 후보가 좁히고 있다는 분석이다.)

In a survey commissioned by SBS from polling firm Ipsos, conducted from the 1st to the 3rd among 800 adults in Seoul (via wireless phone interviews), Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party's Seoul mayoral candidate, garnered 41.4%, while Oh Se-hoon of the PPP received 33.8%. The gap between the two candidates was 7.6 percentage points (p). By age group, apart from those in their 40s and 50s, the gap in approval ratings was within the margin of error (±3.5%p), and the undecided voter bloc stood at 21%. (SBS가 여론조사 업체 입소스에 의뢰해 지난 1~3일 서울 성인 800명을 상대로 실시한 지지율 조사(무선 전화 면접)에서 정원오 민주당 서울시장 후보가 41.4%, 오세훈 국민의힘 후보는 33.8%로 집계됐다. 두 후보의 지지율 격차는 7.6%포인트(p)였다. 연령별로 보면 40~50대를 제외한 나머지 연령대에서 지지율 격차가 오차 범위(±3.5%p) 이내였고, 부동층은 21%였다.)

In major polls, the PPP's party approval rating in Seoul has been stuck in the 20% range. Experts analyze this as a 'decoupling' effect, where Oh Se-hoon is separating from PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk. (주요 여론조사에서 서울에서 국민의힘 정당 지지율은 20%대에 갇혀 있다. 전문가들은 오 시장과 장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 분리되는 ‘디커플링(탈동조화)’ 효과라고 분석했다.)

In a hypothetical two-way matchup survey conducted by Ipsos in February (via wireless phone interviews), Jeong Won-oh, then Seoul's Seongdong-gu district mayor, had 38%, and Oh Se-hoon, then Seoul mayor, had 36%. After the ruling and opposition Seoul mayoral candidates were confirmed, in a wireless automated response (ARS) survey conducted by the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI) on the 22nd and 23rd of last month, the gap between Jeong (45.6%) and Oh (35.4%) widened further to 10.2%p. The undecided bloc was tallied at 12%. (지난 2월 입소스가 실시한 가상 양자 대결 조사(무선 전화 면접)에선 당시 정원오 서울 성동구청장 38%, 오세훈 서울시장 36%였다. 여야 서울시장 후보가 확정된 이후인 지난달 22~23일 한국사회여론연구소(KSOI)가 실시한 무선 자동 응답(ARS) 조사에서 정 후보(45.6%)와 오 후보(35.4%)의 격차는 10.2%p로 더 벌어졌다. 부동층은 12%로 집계됐다.)

However, in the Ipsos survey from early this month, the approval rating gap narrowed, and the undecided bloc increased. In response, Oh's camp stated, "The outcome will be determined by how the 20% undecided bloc moves, depending on issues like real estate." Park Seong-min, head of political consulting firm 'Min', said, "The current low party approval rating for the PPP seems to reflect like or dislike for leader Jang Dong-hyuk," adding, "In other polls conducted under individual candidate names, a trend of catching up to the Democratic Party is emerging." (그러나 이달 초 입소스 조사에선 지지율 격차도 줄고 부동층은 늘어난 것으로 나타났다. 이에 오 후보 측은 “20%에 달하는 부동층이 ‘부동산 이슈’ 등에 따라 어디로 움직이느냐에 따라 승부가 갈릴 것”이라고 했다. 박성민 정치컨설팅 ‘민’ 대표는 “현재 국민의힘의 낮은 당 지지율은 장동혁 대표에 대한 호오(好惡)를 반영하는 것으로 보인다”며 “개별 후보들의 이름으로 실시되는 다른 여론조사에선 민주당을 추격하는 흐름이 만들어지고 있다”고 했다.)

Oh, upon registering as the PPP's Seoul mayoral candidate last month, publicly demanded a shift in direction from the party leadership, and in media interviews, called on Jang to "self-reflect or make a decisive move." (오 후보는 지난달 국민의힘 서울시장 후보로 등록하면서 당 지도부에 노선 변화를 공개적으로 요구했고, 언론 인터뷰에서도 장 대표를 향해 “자숙이나 결단이 필요하다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, regarding the narrowing approval gap, Jeong's camp said, "It appears that the real estate issue has been highlighted, affecting approval ratings," but added, "As a result of Oh failing to fully absorb that support, he also couldn't break the 35% barrier." They further stated, "Some polls fail to re-question respondents who withhold an answer, causing the undecided bloc to appear higher than in other polls," and "We still see a gap of around 10%p." (한편 정 후보 측은 지지율 격차가 좁혀지는 데 대해 “부동산 이슈가 부각되면서 지지율에 영향을 미친 것으로 보인다”면서도 “오 후보가 그 지지율을 충분히 흡수하지 못한 결과, 오 후보도 35%의 벽을 넘지 못했다”고 했다. 그러면서 “일부 여론조사는 응답 유보층에 대해 재질문을 하지 않은 탓에 부동층이 다른 여론조사보다 높게 잡히기도 한다”면서 “우리는 여전히 10%p 안팎의 격차가 나는 것으로 보고 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo Falls Below Party Approval Ratings… Calls for Unification Between Park Min-sik and Han Dong-hoon Intensify (與지지율 밑도는 하정우… 박민식·한동훈 단일화 요구 커진다)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo Falls Below Party Approval Ratings… Calls for Unification Between Park Min-sik and Han Dong-hoon Intensify (與지지율 밑도는 하정우… 박민식·한동훈 단일화 요구 커진다)

Park Min-sik, former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs, was selected on the 5th as the People Power Party’s candidate for the Busan North Gap by-election. This sets the stage for a three-way race between Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo, People Power Party candidate Park Min-sik, and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon. (국민의힘의 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 후보로 박민식 전 국가보훈부 장관이 5일 선출됐다. 이로써 부산 북갑 보궐은 더불어민주당 하정우 후보, 국민의힘 박민식 후보, 무소속 한동훈 후보 간 ‘3자 구도’로 치러지게 됐다.)

The biggest variable in this election is the potential ‘unification of Park Min-sik and Han Dong-hoon.’ Recent polls show the three candidates in a tight contest. While the conservative bloc calls for unification, both candidates have stated their intent to see the race through. People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk is also opposed to unification. However, as the election approaches, demands for conservative unification are expected to grow stronger. (이 선거의 최대 변수로는 ‘박민식·한동훈 단일화’가 꼽힌다. 최근 여론조사에서 세 후보는 접전을 벌이는 양상이다. 야권에선 ‘보수 단일화’ 필요성이 제기되지만 당사자들은 완주 의사를 밝히고 있다. 국민의힘 장동혁 대표도 단일화에 부정적이다. 그러나 선거가 임박할수록 ‘보수 단일화’ 요구는 거세질 것이란 전망이다.)

After being selected as the candidate, Park Min-sik said, “If we reclaim Busan North Gap, Busan will rise again.” He added, “The possibility of unification is zero. Stop wishful thinking.” Han Dong-hoon also maintains his stance, saying, “I will go all the way.” (박민식 후보는 이날 후보에 선출된 뒤 “부산 북갑을 되찾으면 부산이 다시 일어선다”고 했다. 그는 “단일화 가능성은 제로(0)”라며 “더는 희망 회로를 돌리지 마라”고 했다. 한동훈 후보도 “끝까지 가겠다”는 입장이다.)

Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk also drew a line on unification. He stated, “Solidarity with a person once expelled (candidate Han) and solidarity with a different party are clearly separate issues.” Regarding lawmakers from the pro-Han faction supporting Han’s campaign, he hinted at disciplinary actions, saying, “We will clarify the facts and take necessary measures afterward.” (장동혁 대표도 단일화에 선을 그었다. 장 대표는 “제명했던 인사(한 후보)에 대한 연대와 다른 당과의 연대는 분명히 다른 차원”이라고 했다. 그는 한 후보 선거를 지원한 친한계 의원들에 대해선 “사실 관계를 밝히고, 이후 필요한 조치를 하겠다”며 징계를 시사했다.)

Reasons cited for both sides’ positions include recent polls showing Ha Jung-woo’s approval generally lower than the Democratic Party’s support rate, and neither Park nor Han securing a clear advantage. Additionally, both Park and Han believe they can compete even in a three-way race. (양측이 이러는 이유로는 최근 여론조사에서 하정우 후보의 지지율이 민주당 지지율보다 대체로 낮은 점, 박·한 후보 중 누구도 확실한 지지율 우위를 점하지 못한 점이 거론된다. 또 박·한 후보 모두 ‘3자 구도’에서도 해 볼 만하다고 보고 있다.)

Poll results are mixed. A survey by Ipsos and SBS conducted on the 1st–3rd and released on the 5th (mobile phone interview) showed Ha at 38%, Park at 26%, and Han at 21%. Meanwhile, a survey by Han-gil Research and Busan MBC from the same period (landline and mobile ARS) had Ha at 34.3%, Park at 21.5%, and Han at 33.5%. (Refer to the Central Election Poll Review Committee website.) (여론조사 결과는 혼조 양상이다. 입소스·SBS가 지난 1~3일 실시해 5일 발표한 조사(무선 전화 면접)에서 하 후보 38%, 박 후보 26%, 한 후보 21%라는 결과가 나왔다. 그런데 같은 기간 이뤄진 한길리서치·부산 MBC 조사(유·무선 ARS)에서는 하 후보 34.3%, 박 후보 21.5%, 한 후보 33.5%였다. (중앙선거여론조사심의위 홈페이지 참조))

A People Power Party leadership figure said, “Conservative supporters will likely rally,” adding, “Among the three candidates, Park, who is a local native and a two-term lawmaker, will become increasingly advantaged.” Park, born in Busan’s Gupo area, served in the 18th and 19th National Assemblies for Busan North–Gangseo Gap. (국민의힘 지도부 인사는 “앞으로 보수 지지층이 결집할 것”이라며 “세 후보 가운데 지역 출신으로 재선 국회의원까지 지낸 박 후보가 갈수록 유리해질 것”이라고 했다. 부산 구포 출신인 박 후보는 부산 북·강서갑에서 18·19대 의원을 지냈다.)

In contrast, Han Dong-hoon’s camp argued, “Toward the end of the campaign, moderates and ‘reform conservatives,’ along with hardline conservatives, will gravitate toward Han, who has a higher chance of winning.” Another associate noted, “In past parliamentary elections, candidates like Sim Sang-jung, Jang Je-won, and Lee Jun-seok won in three-way races mainly due to name recognition. Han has the highest recognition.” (반면, 한동훈 후보 측은 “선거 막판엔 중도층과 ‘개혁 보수층’ 외에 강경 보수층도 당선 가능성이 높은 한 후보에게 쏠릴 것”이라고 했다. 다른 관계자는 “과거 국회의원 선거에서 심상정·장제원·이준석 등이 3자 구도에서 승리한 주된 이유는 후보 인지도”라며 “한 후보의 인지도가 가장 높다”고 했다.)

Voices within and outside the People Power Party are growing, insisting, “We must unify.” In the last presidential election, Busan North District saw People Power Party candidate Kim Moon-soo (50.2%) outperform President Lee Jae-myung (41.45%). However, Busan North Gap was the only district among Busan’s 18 constituencies where the Democratic Party won in the 2024 general election. Currently, former lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo, running as the Democratic Party’s Busan mayoral candidate, has won three consecutive times there. (국민의힘 안팎에서는 “반드시 단일화해야 한다”는 목소리가 커지고 있다. 부산 북구는 지난 대선에서 국민의힘 김문수 후보(50.2%)가 이재명 대통령(41.45%)보다 득표율이 앞섰던 곳이다. 하지만 부산 북갑은 2024년 총선에서 부산 18곳 지역구 중 유일하게 민주당이 이겼던 지역이기도 하다. 현재 민주당 부산시장 후보로 출마한 전재수 전 의원이 내리 3번 당선됐다.)

People Power Party floor leader and special advisor to the party chair, Kim Dae-sik (Busan Sasang), said today, “Without unification, the election in Busan North Gap will be very difficult for conservatives. We must achieve unification by any means necessary.” Kim reportedly accompanied party leader Jang Dong-hyuk on a recent trip to the U.S. and tried to persuade him on this matter. (국민의힘 당대표 특보단장인 김대식(부산 사상) 의원은 이날 “단일화로 가지 않으면 굉장히 (부산 북갑) 선거, 보수가 어려울 것”이라며 “수단과 방법을 가리지 않고 단일화를 해야 한다”고 했다. 김 의원은 지난달 장동혁 대표의 방미 일정을 동행하면서, 장 대표에게도 이를 설득했다고 한다.)

In the Ipsos and SBS poll (1st–3rd), 64% of People Power Party supporters said unification should happen. Among those favoring unification, suitability for the unified candidate was split: Park at 42% and Han at 41%. (입소스·SBS 여론조사(1~3일)에서는 국민의힘 지지층 64%가 보수 단일화를 ‘해야 한다’고 답했다. 보수 단일화 찬성 응답자 중 단일화 후보 적합도는 박 후보 42%, 한 후보 41%로 팽팽했다.)

Meanwhile, Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo spent the day visiting local figures to appeal for votes. A Democratic Party official said, “The ‘shaking hands and wiping them off’ and ‘oppa’ controversies are fleeting. Assessments of President Lee Jae-myung in Busan North Gap have not been negative. Ha’s approval, currently in the 30% range, is expected to rise gradually.” However, the party is keeping a close eye on the potential impact of the ‘fabricated indictment special counsel law’ issue. (한편 민주당 하정우 후보는 이날 지역 인사를 돌며 표심 호소에 나섰다. 민주당 관계자는 “‘악수 후 손 털기’ ‘오빠’ 논란은 단발성이고, 부산 북갑에서 이재명 대통령에 대한 평가는 나쁘지 않았다”며 “30%대로 묶인 하 후보 지지율도 점차 올라갈 것으로 본다”고 했다. 다만, ‘조작 기소 특검법’ 이슈가 미칠 영향에 대해서는 민주당도 촉각을 곤두세우고 있다.)

item.title: Government: “Investigate Damage After Ship Relocation”… Marine Investigators and Forensic Experts Rushed to Site (정부 “선박 옮긴 후 피해 조사”… 해양 조사관·감식 전문가 현지 급파)
item.description:
Government: “Investigate Damage After Ship Relocation”… Marine Investigators and Forensic Experts Rushed to Site (정부 “선박 옮긴 후 피해 조사”… 해양 조사관·감식 전문가 현지 급파)

On the 5th, the government stated regarding the explosion and fire on the ‘NAMU’, a multi-purpose carrier operated by HMM (formerly Hyundai Merchant Marine), the nation’s largest shipping company, which occurred inside the Strait of Hormuz the previous day, that “the exact cause of the accident will likely be determined through the process of inspecting the damage after the vessel is towed.” It is expected to take at least several days to weeks to confirm whether it was attacked. <<> After a meeting presided over by Senior Secretary Kang Hoon-sik at noon, the Blue House announced, “We plan to immediately dispatch personnel from the local Korean Register branch in Dubai to conduct a safety inspection of the NAMU,” and added, “To ensure a more objective and reliable investigation into the cause, we will urgently send investigators from the Central Maritime Safety Tribunal and forensic experts from the National Fire Agency to the site, separate from the shipping company’s own investigation.” The plan is to tow the NAMU to the nearby Dubai port, then send experts from Korea to analyze the explosion marks and causes at the damaged parts of the hull. <<> The biggest concern is whether Iran attacked our vessel. U.S. President Trump stated that “Iran has taken some shots at nations unrelated (to the war), including Korean cargo ships.” In contrast, our government is taking a cautious stance on whether it was attacked. If it was an attack, fragments or explosive residue could be detected on the hull. <<> The NAMU is known to be a state-of-the-art vessel that began operations in January this year. For this reason, some analyses suggest that the probability of an explosion caused by internal defects is lower than that of an ‘external factor.’ At the time of the explosion, the NAMU was in the waters off Umm Al Quwain, United Arab Emirates (UAE). On that day, Iran launched attacks on the UAE using cruise missiles and drones. This came after the U.S. initiated Operation ‘Project Freedom’, using warships and military aircraft to support the passage of vessels trapped in the Strait of Hormuz, prompting Iran to resume attacks that had ceased following a truce with the U.S. in early last month. On the same day, Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps released a new map of ‘Strait of Hormuz control’, expanding its sphere of control, which included the area around Umm Al Quwain. <<> Some suggest the possibility that Iran carried out a ‘low-intensity provocation’, striking only specific parts with drones, or that fragments from the attack on the UAE caused damage to nearby vessels. Since the outbreak of war between the U.S. and Iran, civilian ships near the Strait of Hormuz have often suffered hull damage from unidentified projectiles or shrapnel. <<> Regarding the safety of the NAMU crew, the Blue House stated that the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and the Cheonghae Unit (naval forces) are maintaining communication to monitor the safety situation in real-time. It added that “we are maintaining close communication with the U.S., Iran, and Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) member states by sharing relevant information with each other.” (5일 정부는 전날 호르무즈 해협 안쪽에서 발생한 국내 최대 국적선사 HMM(옛 현대상선)의 다목적 운반선 ‘나무(NAMU)호’ 폭발·화재에 대해 “정확한 사고 원인은 선박 예인 후 피해 상태를 확인하는 과정에서 파악할 수 있을 것”이라고 밝혔다. 피격 여부 확인에는 최소 수일에서 수주가 걸릴 전망이다.)

item.title: U.S. Deputy Secretary of State: “Undergoing a Major Overhaul of Visa System to Address Korean Companies’ Concerns” (美국무부 부장관 “한국 기업 우려 해소 위해 비자 제도 대대적 개편 중”)
item.description:
U.S. Deputy Secretary of State: “Undergoing a Major Overhaul of Visa System to Address Korean Companies’ Concerns” (美국무부 부장관 “한국 기업 우려 해소 위해 비자 제도 대대적 개편 중”)

Christopher Landau, the U.S. Deputy Secretary of State, said on the 5th, “I am well aware that the U.S. visa system was not designed to accommodate visitors with special purposes, such as companies trying to (train American workers),” and added, “We are carrying out a major overhaul of the visa system to address the concerns of Korean authorities and companies.” Landau made these remarks during a press conference held that afternoon at the SelectUSA event in National Harbor, Maryland, stating, “The agreements we have made with the Korean government are really important opportunities for Korea’s capital and know-how to be invested in the United States for the benefit of both countries.” <<> Last year, South Korea and the United States signed a trade agreement that includes $350 billion (approximately 514 trillion won) in Korean investment in the U.S. The first project is reportedly slated to be the construction of a liquefied natural gas (LNG) export terminal in Louisiana. However, as seen in last year’s incident involving the detention of Korean workers at the Hyundai Motor and LG Energy Solution plant in Georgia, visa issues must be resolved first for investment projects to take root through the education and training of local workers. Landau, who noted that he was the first senior U.S. State Department official to visit Korea after the Georgia incident, said, “A certain number of Korean personnel need to come in (to the U.S.) for education or other purposes,” adding, “We need to ensure that the immigration and visa laws, which we enforce very strictly, do not become an obstacle to investment.” <<> In December last year, a dedicated desk for ‘Korean Investment and Visits (KIT)’ was launched at the U.S. Embassy in Seoul, handling business travel-related issues and providing guidance on visa travel. Separately, in the House of Representatives, Korean American Congressman Young Kim, chair of the House Foreign Affairs Subcommittee on Asia and the Pacific, introduced the ‘Partner with Korea Act (PWKA),’ which aims to create 15,000 dedicated E-4 employment visas per year for skilled Korean professionals. The Korean Embassy has also hired a lobbyist to conduct outreach to Congress, and some Senate offices in districts where Korean companies have invested are reportedly showing interest in proposing a bill. Landau said, “Our task is to harmonize immigration policy and attracting more investment (to the U.S.).” <<> Meanwhile, regarding relations with Europe, Landau said that day, “The United States has the largest market in the world, but I believe the relationship we’ve had with our European partners has not been healthy for a while,” adding, “This is not limited to the economic sphere. Ultimately, the U.S. and Europe need to reach a new agreement.” President Donald Trump recently notified European automakers of tariff increases on cars from Europe, citing the failure of NATO member countries to cooperate on the situation in Iran. Landau said, “I don’t think a yo-yo relationship between the U.S. and Europe is healthy,” and “I believe the U.S. has borne an excessive burden for too long. I think it’s time to establish a new balance.” <<> Landau is spearheading the Trump administration’s core policy of ‘commercial diplomacy,’ acting as a key figure in reviving U.S. manufacturing and attracting investment. He has previously described South Korea as an “absolutely essential partner” for manufacturing revival. He stated, “One of the core goals of a country’s foreign policy is to gain benefits through trade with other nations,” and added, “I believe that in recent decades, U.S. diplomacy has lost its focus on the economy and trade.” (크리스토퍼 랜다우 미 국무부 부장관은 5일 “미국의 비자 시스템이 (미국 노동자를) 교육하려는 기업인 등 특별한 목적을 가진 방문객을 수용할 수 있도록 설계되지 않았다는 점을 잘 알고 있다”며 “한국 당국과 기업의 우려를 해소하기 위해 비자 제도를 대대적으로 개편하고 있다”고 했다. 랜다우는 이날 오후 메릴랜드주(州) 내셔널 하버 ‘셀렉트USA’ 현장에서 열린 기자회견에서 “한국 정부와 맺은 협정은 한국의 자본, 노하우가 양국의 이익을 위해 미국에 투입될 수 있는 정말 중요한 기회들”이라며 이같이 밝혔다.)

item.title: Korea Promises $500 Trillion in U.S. Investment... Love Calls Pour In at U.S. Investment Expo [Report] (500조 대미 투자 약속한 한국… 美투자박람회서 러브콜 쏟아졌다 [르포])
item.description:
Korea Promises $500 Trillion in U.S. Investment... Love Calls Pour In at U.S. Investment Expo [Report] (500조 대미 투자 약속한 한국… 美투자박람회서 러브콜 쏟아졌다 [르포] )

"Just in case you forgot (ICYMI), Hyundai is investing nearly $6 billion (about 8.81 trillion won) in a Louisiana steel mill, creating 1,300 jobs." (“혹시나 잊었을까봐 알려드립니다(ICYMI). 현대가 루이지애나 제철소에 거의 60억 달러(약 8조8100억원)를 투자해 1300개의 직업을 창출합니다.”)

At the 'SelectUSA Investment Summit' held in National Harbor, Maryland on the 5th, each state had set up booths, showcasing their unique strengths and fiercely courting potential investors. Upon entering the Louisiana booth, one could see an interior photo of Hyundai Steel's mill, along with the Korean word '환영' (Welcome) written in large letters on the ceiling. Last March, Hyundai Motor Chairman Chung Eui-sun announced plans to build a steel mill with an annual capacity of 2.7 million tons, with figures like President Donald Trump at the White House, House Speaker Mike Johnson (representing Louisiana), and House Majority Whip Steve Scalise in attendance. A state official said, "There are high expectations that Hyundai's investment will inject new vitality into the local community." (5일 찾은 메릴랜드주(州) 내셔널 하버의 ‘셀렉트USA 인베스트먼트 서밋’ 현장에는 각 주가 부스를 차려 놓고 저마다의 특장점을 뽐내며 잠재적 투자자들을 상대로 치열한 구애를 하고 있었다. 루이지애나 부스에 들어서니 현대제철 제철소 내부 사진과 함께 지붕 위에 ‘환영’이란 한국어가 큰 글씨로 새겨져 있었다. 정의선 현대차 회장은 지난해 3월 백악관에서 도널드 트럼프 대통령, 루이지애나가 지역구인 마이크 존슨 하원의장, 스티븐 스컬리스 공화당 하원 원내 총무 등 실력자들이 지켜보는 가운데 연산 270만 톤 규모의 제철소 건설 계획을 밝혔다. 주 관계자는 “현대의 투자가 지역 사회에 새로운 활력을 불어넣을 것이란 기대가 크다”고 했다.)

'SelectUSA,' hosted by the U.S. Department of Commerce since 2013, is an investment expo where economic development organization (EDO) officials representing all 50 states gather to pitch investment opportunities to thousands of businesspeople and government delegates from over 100 countries. Last November, South Korea and the U.S. agreed via a fact sheet on Korea's $350 billion (about 514 trillion won) investment in the U.S. At this year's event, Korean business representatives were treated as VIPs. The organizers provided simultaneous Korean interpretation services, and Georgia, which has seen a concentration of Korean corporate investments to the point where it's said to "live off Korea," even prepared guidebooks in Korean. The booklet was packed with appeal points, including the peach, Georgia's state fruit, along with its pro-business environment, top-ranked universities, and the world's busiest airport with direct flights to 50 countries. West Virginia featured a map showing investment locations of Korean companies like POSCO, LG, and KCC. Maryland, home to the headquarters of 'IonQ'—a quantum computing company that excites Korean retail investors (Seohak ants)—showcased the slogan 'Quantum Capital.' (상무부가 2013년부터 주최하는 ‘셀렉트USA’는 미국 50주를 대표하는 경제개발청(EDO) 관계자들이 총집결해 100여국에서 온 기업인, 정부 사절 수천 명을 대상으로 투지 유치 활동을 벌이는 투자 박람회다. 지난해 11월 한미가 팩트시트를 통해 한국의 3500억 달러(약 514조원) 대미(對美) 투자에 합의한 가운데, 올해 행사에서는 한국 기업 관계자들이 귀한 손님 대접을 받았다. 주최 측은 한국어 동시 통역 서비스를 제공했고, ‘한국 때문에 먹고 산다’는 얘기가 나올 정도로 우리 기업의 대미 투자가 집중된 조지아의 경우 아예 한국어로 된 안내 책자를 비치했다. 책자에는 조지아를 상징하는 과일인 복숭아와 함께 친(親)기업 환경, 최고 순위 대학, 50국 직항 항공편이 있는 세계에서 가장 바쁜 공항 등 어필할 수 있는 요소를 빼곡하게 담았다. 웨스트버지니아는 포스코, LG, KCC 등 한국 기업의 투자 현황을 지도에 기재했다. 또 서학개미가 열광하는 양자 기업인 ‘아이온큐’ 본사가 있는 메릴랜드는 “양자 수도(Quantam Capital)‘라는 슬로건을 내걸었다.)

At a Korea-U.S. investment networking reception held the previous day on a rooftop terrace in Washington, D.C., White House officials reportedly attended and emphasized the importance of Korean investments. Additionally, Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau, who leads the Trump administration's key 'commercial diplomacy' initiative, stated at a press conference that day, "We are undertaking a major overhaul of the visa system to address the concerns of Korean companies." Landau is a figure who has identified Korea as a key partner for reviving U.S. manufacturing. Taking advantage of this expo, South Korea's Ministry of Foreign Affairs held its first joint meeting of 38 honorary Korean liaison officers, or 'Korea Desk' officials, from each state. With the passage of the Special Act on U.S. Investment accelerating investment in the U.S., these officials are expected to serve as facilitators for each project. They said, "As dedicated channels within state governments connecting cooperation with Korea, we will do our best." (전날 워싱턴 DC의 한 루프 테라스에서 열린 한미 투자 네트워킹 리셉션에는 백악관 관계자들도 참석해 한국 기업의 투자가 갖는 중요성에 대해 강조했다고 한다. 또 트럼프 정부 핵심 기조인 ‘상업 외교’를 주도하고 있는 크리스토퍼 랜다우 국무부 부장관은 이날 기자회견에서 “한국 기업의 우려를 해소할 수 있도록 비자 시스템을 대대적으로 개편하고 있다”고 밝혔다. 랜다우는 한국을 미국 제조업 부흥을 위한 핵심 파트너로 꼽았던 인사다. 우리 외교부는 이번 박람회를 계기로 각 주별로 있는 명예직 한국 담당관인 ‘코리아 데스크’ 관계자 38명도 모여 첫 연합 회의를 열었다. 대미투자특별법 통과로 대미 투자에 속도가 나고 있는데, 이들이 프로젝트별 촉진자 역할을 할 것으로 기대된다. 이들은 “한국과의 협력을 연결하는 주 정부 내 전담 창구로서 최선을 다할 것”이라고 했다.)

Since Trump took office, emphasizing 'America First' and investment in the U.S., 'SelectUSA' is seen as having grown even more intense compared to previous years. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick stated, "The U.S. is the best consumer market in the world," and "We invite investment into the U.S." The vastly different marketing tactics of each state are also one of the highlights of the event. State governors acted as 'top salespeople,' roaming the venue, while ambassadors brought companies from their host countries to the site. Alaska, which is serious about energy cooperation with Korea, had a large signboard shaped like a 'bear holding a salmon' and held a business card drawing event for a cruise ticket to see Arctic glaciers. A state government official said, "We have many key minerals used in cars and electronics, making it an ideal place for Korean companies to invest." Texas, which, like Georgia, is an economic growth engine in the South with concentrated Korean investments, distributed a directory with names, titles, and emails of 48 regional investment attraction officials, with the slogan, "Find your future in Texas." (트럼프가 취임 후 미국 우선주의, 대미 투자를 강조하면서 ‘셀렉트USA’는 그 열기가 예년에 비해 더 뜨거워졌다는 평가를 받는다. 하워드 러트닉 상무장관은 “미국은 세계에서 가장 훌륭한 소비 시장”이라며 “미국으로의 투자를 초대한다”고 했다. 각 주마다 천차만별인 마케팅 포인트도 행사를 즐기는 관전 포인트 중 하나다. 각 주지사가 ‘1호 영업 사원’을 자처하며 행사장 곳곳을 누볐고, 대사들은 주재국 기업을 이끌고 현장을 찾았다. 한국과의 에너지 협력에 진심인 알래스카는 ‘연어를 들고 있는 곰’ 모양의 대형 입간판과 함께 추첨을 통해 북극 빙하를 볼 수 있는 크루즈 탑승권을 건 명함 응모 이벤트를 하고 있었다. 주 정부 관계자는 “자동차, 전자 기기에 들어가는 핵심 광물이 다수 매장돼 있어 한국 기업이 투자하기에 안성맞춤일 것”이라고 했다. 조지아와 마찬가지로 한국 기업의 투자가 집중된 남부의 경제 성장 엔진인 텍사스는 “텍사스에서 여러분의 미래를 찾으라”며 48개 지역 투자 유치 담당자의 이름과 직함, 메일이 담긴 주소록을 배포했다.)

item.title: ‘Yoon’s guardian warrior’ Lee Yong: “The Yoon administration is sorry for causing pain to the people”... Declares candidacy in tears (‘尹 호위 무사’ 이용 “尹정권, 국민께 상처드려 죄송”... 눈물로 출마 선언)
item.description:
‘Yoon’s guardian warrior’ Lee Yong: “The Yoon administration is sorry for causing pain to the people”... Declares candidacy in tears (‘尹 호위 무사’ 이용 “尹정권, 국민께 상처드려 죄송”... 눈물로 출마 선언)

Lee Yong, the People Power Party candidate running in the June 3 by-election for Gyeonggi Hanam-gap, apologized on the 6th regarding the December 3 martial law, stating, “Now that the Yoon Seok-yeol administration has caused disappointment and pain to the people, I too am not free from responsibility.” Candidate Lee served as the chief aide during Yoon Seok-yeol’s presidential campaign, earning the nickname ‘Yoon Seok-yeol’s guardian warrior.’ He is a former national team coach for bobsleigh and skeleton and served as a lawmaker in the 21st National Assembly. (6·3 경기 하남갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 출마하는 국민의힘 이용 후보는 6일 “윤석열 정권이 국민께 실망과 상처를 드린 지금, 저 역시 책임에서 자유롭지 않는다”면서 12·3 계엄에 대해 사과했다. 이 후보는 윤석열 전 대통령의 대선 후보 시절 수행실장을 맡으면서 ‘윤석열 호위 무사’로 불렸다. 그는 봅슬레이 스켈레톤 국가대표 감독 출신으로 21대 국회의원을 지냈다.)

Speaking at a press conference at the National Assembly that morning to declare his candidacy, Candidate Lee said, “I will not avoid the mistakes of the government we created,” and continued, “I am sorry. I sincerely apologize. I will not make excuses. I will not hide. I will not avoid the discipline the people give me.” Candidate Lee shed tears during the press conference. (이 후보는 이날 오전 국회에서 출마 선언 기자회견을 열고 “저는 우리가 창출한 정권의 과오를 피하지 않겠다”면서 이렇게 말했다. 그는 “죄송하다. 진심으로 사과드린다”며 “변명하지 않겠다. 숨지 않겠다. 국민께서 주시는 회초리를 피하지 않겠다”고 했다. 이 후보는 기자회견 도중 눈물을 보이기도 했다.)

Further, Candidate Lee stated, “If you were part of creating a government, you must also take responsibility in the face of that government’s failures,” adding, “I will change starting with myself. I will take responsibility for what must be taken. I will fix what needs fixing.” (그러면서 이 후보는 “정권을 만드는 일에 함께했다면 그 정권의 실패 앞에서도 책임을 져야 한다”며 “저부터 달라지겠다. 책임질 것은 책임지겠다. 고칠 것은 고치겠다”고 했다.)

In this regard, Candidate Lee told reporters, “(During the 2022 presidential election) our party’s goal was to win power. I ran hard toward that goal and contributed (to the creation of the Yoon Seok-yeol administration). If the previous government disappointed the people, I think I share that responsibility, so I expressed deep regret.” (이와 관련 이 후보는 기자들과 만나 “(지난 2022년 대선 당시) 우리 당의 목표는 정권 창출이었다. 저도 목표에 맞게 열심히 뛰었고 (윤석열 정권 창출에) 일조했다”며 “지난 정권이 국민에게 실망을 안겼다면 그 또한 책임이 있지 않나 생각해서 통감한다고 했다”고 했다.)

Furthermore, in his candidacy declaration, Candidate Lee said, “I stand before the citizens of Hanam with a heavy sense of responsibility,” and “I declare my candidacy in this by-election to restore the collapsed rule of law and democracy and to open a greater tomorrow for Hanam, the foundation of my life.” Targeting former Democratic Party lawmaker Choo Mi-ae and Gyeonggi Hanam-gap candidate Lee Kwang-jae, he said, “Hanam is not a temporary nest for migratory birds that come and go.” (또한 이 후보는 출마 선언에서 “하남시민 앞에 무거운 책임감으로 섰다”며 “무너진 법치와 민주주의를 바로 세우고 제 삶의 터전인 하남의 내일을 더 크게 열기 위해 이번 보궐선거 출마를 선언한다”고 말했다. 이 후보는 더불어민주당 추미애 전 의원, 이광재 경기 하남갑 후보를 겨냥해 “하남은 철새들이 잠시 머물다 떠나는 둥지가 아니다”라고 했다.)

Candidate Lee stated, “As people’s livelihoods collapse, the Lee Jae-myung administration and the Democratic Party are obsessed only with holding onto power,” and “The ‘covering for Lee Jae-myung’ parliamentary investigation and the indictment-cancellation special counsel law are unconstitutional and illegal. They are arrogant and unscrupulous.” He added, “At a time when they should be looking after people’s livelihoods, controlling prices, and listening to the sighs of merchants and self-employed workers, the Democratic Party is using the National Assembly solely to protect one person, Lee Jae-myung.” (이 후보는 “민생은 무너지는데 이재명 정권과 민주당은 권력 지키기에만 몰두하고 있다”며 “이재명 죄지우기 국정조사, 공소취소 특검법은 위헌적이고 탈법적이다. 오만하고 무도하다”고 했다. 그는 “민생을 챙겨야 할 시간에, 물가를 잡아야 할 시간에, 상인과 자영업자의 한숨을 들어야 할 시간에, 민주당은 오직 이재명 한 사람을 지키는 데 국회를 쓰고 있다”고 했다.)

Candidate Lee also criticized the Lee Jae-myung administration’s economic, real estate, and security policies. He said, “I will stop the Democratic Party’s rampage. I will check the arrogance of the Lee Jae-myung administration,” and “I will re-establish the foundations of the rule of law, fairness, and liberal democracy.” (그러면서 이 후보는 이재명 정부의 경제, 부동산, 안보 정책 등도 비판했다. 이 후보는 “민주당의 폭주를 멈추겠다. 이재명 정권의 오만을 견제하겠다”며 “법치와 공정, 자유민주주의의 기본을 다시 세우겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Yeongnam Conservatives Unite Over Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel Bill…PFP Candidates: “Lee Is Not the King of South Korea” (조작 기소 특검법에 영남 보수 결집…국힘 후보들 “李, 대한민국 왕 아니다”)
item.description:
Yeongnam Conservatives Unite Over Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel Bill…PFP Candidates: “Lee Is Not the King of South Korea” (조작 기소 특검법에 영남 보수 결집…국힘 후보들 “李, 대한민국 왕 아니다”)

Candidates for local government heads in the Yeongnam region from the People’s Power Party gathered on the 6th to denounce the Democratic Party of Korea’s proposal of a special counsel bill on manipulated indictments, declaring in unison, “President Lee Jae-myung is not the king of South Korea.” The bill aims to investigate whether 12 cases, including the 8 for which President Lee has been indicted, involved manipulated indictments. It was spearheaded by Democratic Party lawmakers who previously served as President Lee’s legal counsel. The special counsel’s authority also includes the power to determine whether to withdraw prosecutions in the investigated cases. (국민의힘 영남권 광역 단체장 후보들이 6일 더불어민주당의 조작 기소 특검법 발의에 대해 한자리에 모여 “이재명 대통령은 대한민국 왕이 아니다”며 일제히 규탄했다. 조작 기소 특검법은 이 대통령이 기소된 8개 사건 포함 12개 사건의 조작 기소 여부를 살펴보겠다는 내용으로, 이 대통령 변호인 출신 민주당 의원들이 주도해 만들었다. 특검 권한에는 수사 대상 사건들의 공소 취소 여부도 판단할 수 있게 해놨다.)

Candidates from the People’s Power Party in Busan, Ulsan, South Gyeongsang, Daegu, and North Gyeongsang held a joint press conference in Ulsan on the same day to denounce the Democratic Party’s “Prosecution Withdrawal Special Counsel Bill.” This issue has become a central topic in the current local elections. President Lee has stated that the bill is “necessary” but added that “the timing and procedure for handling it should be decided by the ruling party after gathering public opinion and thorough deliberation.” The Democratic Party is reportedly considering processing the bill after the local elections. (국민의힘 부산·울산·경남·대구·경북 후보들은 이날 울산에 모여 ‘민주당 공소 취소 특검법 규탄 기자회견’을 열었다. 공소 취소 특검 이슈는 현재 지방선거의 핵심 이슈로 작용하고 있다. 이 대통령은 이 특검법에 대해 “필요하다”면서도 “(법안 처리) 시기와 절차는 여당이 국민적 의견 수렴과 숙의 과정을 거쳐서 판단해 달라”고 했고, 민주당은 지방선거 이후로 법안을 처리하겠다는 생각이라고 한다.)

Busan Mayor candidate Park Hyung-joon said, “Another problem with the ‘Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel Bill’ is that it is a ‘Crime-Elimination Special Counsel Bill’ that allows the president to erase his own crimes.” He added, “It also violates the principle of equality under Article 11 of the Constitution, which states that all citizens are equal before the law and shall not be discriminated against.” Park continued, “Power that seeks to stand above the law is anti-democratic and anti-republican. The Republic of Korea, as a democratic republic, firmly rejects this. President Lee is not the king of South Korea.” (박형준 부산시장 후보는 이날 “‘조작 기소 특검법’의 또 다른 문제는 대통령 스스로 자신의 죄를 삭제하는 ‘삭죄 특검법’이라는 것”이라며 “대한민국 헌법 제11조 ‘모든 국민은 법 앞에 평등하며, 차별받지 않는다’는 평등의 원칙에도 어긋난다”고 했다. 박 후보는 “법 위에 군림하려는 권력은 반민주적 권력이고, 반공화적 권력이며, 민주공화국인 대한민국은 이를 강력히 거부한다”며 “이 대통령은 대한민국의 왕이 아니다”고 했다.)

Daegu Mayor candidate Choo Kyung-ho said, “The essence of the Prosecution Withdrawal Special Counsel Bill is clear. It is an arrogant declaration that no one can question President Lee’s crimes.” He described it as “an unconstitutional idea that seeks to seize the values of the separation of powers and judicial independence entirely into President Lee’s personal hands, and as an imperial tyranny forcing the people to surrender.” Choo added, “President Lee, perhaps fearing public resistance, is only talking about adjusting the timing. It is a cowardly and shallow trick to simply avoid the local elections.” (추경호 대구시장 후보는 “공소 취소 특검법의 본질은 분명하다. 이 대통령의 범죄를 국민 누구도 묻지 말라는 오만한 선언”이라며 “삼권분립은 물론, 사법부 독립이라는 헌법 가치를 통째로 이 대통령 개인 손아귀에 움켜쥐려는 초헌법적 발상이자, 국민에게 항복을 강요하는 제왕적 폭거”라고 했다. 추 후보는 “이 대통령은 국민의 저항이 두려운지 (특검법 처리) 시기 조절만 운운하고 있다”며 “지방선거만 피하고 보자는 비겁하고 얄팍한 꼼수”라고 했다.)

Ulsan Mayor candidate Kim Doo-gyeom said, “The so-called ‘Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel Bill’ is not a law. It is a judicial coup and judicial rebellion disguised in legislative form.” He added, “Even during the military dictatorship in South Korea’s history, such a thing never happened.” North Gyeongsang Governor candidate Lee Cheol-woo said, “President Lee must exercise his veto power over this bill. If he does not exercise the veto…” <<> “…he would be abandoning his constitutional duty to uphold the law.” South Gyeongsang Governor candidate Park Wan-soo said, “President Lee’s trials are suspended during his term, posing no obstacle to state affairs. Attempting to withdraw prosecutions during his term to eliminate his own cases goes beyond privatization of power and is an unconstitutional act.” He added, “The ruling party, intoxicated by power, is directly challenging the authority of the people and the Constitution, declaring that the president stands above the law.” (김두겸 울산시장 후보는 “이른바 ‘조작 기소 특검법’은 법이 아니다”며 “입법의 외피를 쓴 사법 쿠데타이자, 사법 내란”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “대한민국 역사상 군사 독재 시절에도 없던 일”이라고 했다. 이철우 경북지사 후보는 “이 대통령은 반드시 (특검법에 대해) 거부권을 행사해야 한다”며 “거부권을 행사하지 않는다면)

item.title: President Lee: “There Is No Myth of an Unbeatable Real Estate Market” (李 대통령 “부동산 불패 신화는 없다”)
item.description:
President Lee: “There Is No Myth of an Unbeatable Real Estate Market” (李 대통령 “부동산 불패 신화는 없다”)

President Lee Jae-myung said on the 6th, “Normalizing the real estate market is an inevitable trend of the times and a key national task that must be carried out.” President Lee made this statement while sharing an article on his X (formerly Twitter) account, which reported that about half of real estate experts and licensed real estate agents predict a decline in housing prices. (이재명 대통령은 6일 “부동산 정상화는 피할 수 없는 시대적 흐름이자 반드시 해야 할 국가의 핵심 과제”라고 했다. 이 대통령은 이날 자신의 엑스(X·옛 트위터) 계정에 부동산 전문가와 공인 중개사들 절반가량이 집값 하락을 전망했다는 취지의 기사를 공유하며 이같이 밝혔다.)

The article was written citing the KB Management Research Institute’s ‘KB Real Estate Report’ and noted a significant drop in predictions of rising housing prices and an increase in forecasts of declines, compared to a survey conducted about three months ago in January. (해당 기사는 KB금융지주 경영연구소의 ‘KB부동산 보고서’를 인용해 작성된 것으로, 약 석 달 전인 1월 조사에 비해 집값 상승 예측이 큰 폭으로 줄고 하락 전망이 늘어났다는 내용을 담고 있다.)

President Lee said, “An unbeatable real estate market? That myth no longer exists,” adding, “Just like the cleanup of illegal facilities in valleys and the recovery of the stock market, everything in South Korea is returning to normal.” (이 대통령은 “부동산 불패? 이제 그런 신화는 없다”며 “계곡 불법 시설 정비, 주식시장 정상 회복처럼 대한민국의 모든 것들이 정상을 되찾고 있다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee also shared media reports about the so-called ‘wildfire cartel’—involving shell companies and other insolvent firms participating in bids while authorities turned a blind eye—hindering the proper recovery of wildfire damage. He expressed gratitude for the reports and said, “I have instructed the cabinet to look into the situation where such structural corruption and misconduct were neglected for a long time, and to review fundamental countermeasures and disciplinary actions.” (한편 이 대통령은 또 산불 피해 복구가 제대로 이뤄지지 않는 배경에 페이퍼컴퍼니 등 부실 업체의 입찰 참여 및 이를 방치한 이른바 ‘산불 카르텔’이 있다는 내용의 언론 보도를 공유하며 “보도에 감사드린다”며 “내각에 이런 구조적 부정·비리를 장기간 방치한 상황에 대해 파악하고 근본적 대책과 문책 방안을 검토하라고 지시했다”고 전했다.)

item.title: As KOSPI Surpasses 7,000, Chung Cheong-rae Says "Thanks to Trust in Lee's Governance… Hope the People Power Party Joins In" (코스피 7000 돌파에 정청래 “李 국정 신뢰 덕분…국힘도 동참하길”)
item.description:
As KOSPI Surpasses 7,000, Chung Cheong-rae Says "Thanks to Trust in Lee's Governance… Hope the People Power Party Joins In" (코스피 7000 돌파에 정청래 “李 국정 신뢰 덕분…국힘도 동참하길”)

Chung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 6th regarding the KOSPI index surpassing the 7,000 mark, "It hit 7,200, the highest ever since Korea's founding. It's an astonishing figure." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 6일 코스피 지수가 7000선을 넘은 것에 대해 “단군 이래 가장 높은 코스피 7200을 찍었다. 경이로운 수치”라고 했다.)

At the party's Supreme Council meeting that day, Leader Chung said, "The KOSPI index, which couldn't even reach 3,000 under the Yoon Seok-yeol administration, has more than doubled in less than a year since the Lee Jae-myung government was launched," adding, "I believe it's because trust in Korean capital, which had been undervalued, has been restored." (정 대표는 이날 당 최고위원회의에서 “윤석열 정권 때 3000도 못 됐던 코스피 지수가 이재명 정부 출범 1년도 안 돼서 2배 이상으로 뛰었다”며 “그동안 저평가됐던 한국 자본에 대한 신뢰가 회복됐기 때문이라고 생각한다”고 했다.)

Leader Chung interpreted this by saying, "This much stability in state affairs and the disappearance of the 'Korea risk' are driving up the trust capital in the Republic of Korea," and "The trust in President Lee Jae-myung's governance, which is accelerating the normalization of the country, is creating a synergistic effect." (정 대표는 “그만큼 국정이 안정되고 ‘코리아 리스크’가 사라지면서 대한민국에 대한 신뢰 자본이 상승하고 있기 때문이라고 해석한다”며 “대한민국 국가 정상화에 박차를 가하고 있는 이재명 대통령의 국정에 대한 신뢰가 상승 작용을 일으키고 있다”고 했다.)

Leader Chung remarked, "We are a country that lives on exports and has a highly externally dependent economic structure," adding, "Diplomacy, defense, and security must be crucial factors, and I believe this area is lifting things up." (정 대표는 “우리는 수출로 먹고사는 나라고, 대외 의존성이 높은 경제 구조를 갖고 있다”며 “외교·국방·안보가 대단히 중요한 요소일 텐데 이 부분이 끌어올리고 있다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

He continued, "Another thing to note is the stabilization of housing prices and the real estate market, which President Lee firmly emphasized several times through social media," and "I think that effect is transferring to the KOSPI, thus driving up stock prices." (그는 이어 “또 하나 주목할 것은 이 대통령이 직접 소셜미디어를 통해 수 차례 강력한 의지를 밝혔던 집값 안정, 부동산 시장 안정”이라며 “그 효과가 코스피로 옮겨서 이렇게 주가를 끌어올리고 있다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

Leader Chung said, "At a time when the Republic of Korea's national prestige and status are being recognized globally as a model country, seeing the People Power Party still attacking the Lee Jae-myung government with color-based rhetoric makes me wonder, 'Are these people living in the same 21st century?'" He added, "I hope the People Power Party, which brings out decades-old, outdated color-based attacks as if living in isolation like the Galapagos, will quickly change its mindset and join this rising tide of national fortune." (정 대표는 “이렇게 대한민국 국격과 위상이, 그리고 대한민국이 모범국가로 세계적으로 인정받고 있는 이때에 국민의힘은 아직도 이재명 정부를 색깔론으로 공격하고 있는 것을 보며 ‘21세기 같은 시대를 살고 있는 사람들인가’ 이런 생각이 든다”며 “수십 년 전 낡은 색깔론을 들고 와서 마치 갈라파고스에서 사는 것처럼 고립된 사고에 젖어 있는 국민의힘은 하루속히 마음을 바꿔먹고 국운이 상승하는 이 대열에 동참하길 바란다”고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "Partial constitutional amendment is realistic... I ask for a vote in the National Assembly tomorrow." (李 “부분 개헌이 현실적... 내일 국회서 표결해달라”)
item.description:
Lee: "Partial constitutional amendment is realistic... I ask for a vote in the National Assembly tomorrow." (李 “부분 개헌이 현실적... 내일 국회서 표결해달라”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 6th, ahead of the National Assembly vote on the constitutional amendment bill, "Proceeding with partial amendments sequentially, as much as there is consensus, is a realistic approach," and added, "For a constitutional amendment that there is no reason to oppose, the vote will take place tomorrow. I hope it will be carried out tomorrow." (이재명 대통령은 6일 헌법 개정안의 국회 표결을 앞두고 “부분 개헌을 합의되는 만큼 순차적으로 해나가는 게 현실적인 방법”이라며 “반대할 이유가 없는 헌법 개정안에 표결이 내일 이루어진다. 내일 실천했으면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

Chairing a joint Cabinet meeting and emergency economic review at the Cheong Wa Dae, President Lee said, "Under the current Constitution, it is difficult to fully guarantee the level of democracy in our Republic of Korea, the living conditions of our people, or the future of our nation," making this statement. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 국무회의 겸 비상경제점검회의를 주재해 “지금 헌법으로는 현재 우리 대한민국 민주주의의 수준이나 국민의 삶의 상황 또 국가의 미래를 충분히 담보하기가 어렵다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

He continued, "At the same time, the burden of a full-scale constitutional amendment is too great," and "Political interests clash, making consensus difficult, but we should not postpone everything. We need to approach this with a pragmatic attitude of doing what we can." (이어 “동시에 전면개헌을 하기엔 부담이 너무 크다”며 “정치적 이해관계가 엇갈려 합의가 쉽지 않은데, 그렇다고 다 미룰 건 아니고 할 수 있는 만큼은 하자는 이런 실용적 태도로 접근할 필요가 있다”고 했다.)

President Lee added, "For example, who among the people would oppose preventing illegal martial law or strengthening checks on the National Assembly?" He said, "There might be a few who oppose it, but wouldn’t we have to view them as advocates of illegal martial law?" He further stated, "It is only natural to prevent someone from declaring martial law, which is not a martial law situation, illegally to maintain power or for private gain, in order to pursue dictatorship." (이 대통령은 “예컨대 불법계엄을 더 이상 못하게 하자, 국회 통제를 강화하자는 걸 어느 국민이 반대하겠느냐”면서 “반대하는 사람이 조금 있을 수는 있겠지만, 그 사람들은 불법계엄 옹호론자로 봐야 되지 않겠느냐”라고 했다. 그러면서 “계엄 상황도 아닌데 불법적으로 정권 유지, 사익을 목적으로 계엄을 선포해서 독재를 하겠다는 것을 못하게 하는 게 당연한 것”이라고 했다.)

The constitutional amendment bill set to be presented at the plenary session on the 7th was proposed on the 3rd by 187 lawmakers, including members from six parties in the National Assembly—the Democratic Party of Korea, the Rebuilding Korea Party, the Progressive Party, the Reform Party, the Basic Income Party, and the Social Democratic Party—as well as six independents. The bill includes provisions that require National Assembly approval when the president declares martial law, and that martial law loses effect immediately if the approval is rejected or not granted within 48 hours of the declaration. (오는 7일 본회의에 오르는 개헌안은 더불어민주당·조국혁신당·진보당·개혁신당·기본소득당·사회민주당 등 원내 6당과 무소속 6명을 포함해 187명이 지난 3일 발의했다. 개헌안에는 대통령의 계엄 선포시 국회의 승인을 받아야 한다는 내용과 함께, 승인이 부결되거나 계엄을 선포한 때로부터 48시간이 될 때까지 승인이 이뤄지지 않으면 계엄이 즉시 효력을 상실한다는 내용이 담겼다.)

Additionally, the preamble of the Constitution includes the "succession of democratic ideals from the Busan-Masan Democratization Movement and the May 18 Democratization Movement." It does not include any reorganizational plans for power structures, such as the current four-year presidential term limit system. For the amendment to pass, it requires approval from two-thirds of the total members (191), meaning at least 12 lawmakers from the People Power Party must vote in favor. However, the People Power Party maintains a party line opposing the amendment. (이와 함께 헌법 전문에 ‘부마민주항쟁과 5·18민주화운동의 민주이념 계승’이 포함됐다. 현재 대통령 4년 중임제 등과 같은 권력구조에 대한 개편 방안은 담기지 않았다. 개헌안이 통과하려면 재적 의원 3분의 2인 191명이 찬성이 필요해 국민의힘에서 최소 12명이 찬성표를 던져야 한다. 하지만 국민의힘은 개헌안 반대를 당론으로 유지하고 있다.)

Regarding the June 3 local elections, President Lee stated, "I urge a very bold, swift, and strict response to crimes such as engaging in black propaganda to slander opponents, distributing money to disrupt the election order and buy votes, and public officials intervening in elections." (이 대통령은 6·3 지방선거와 관련해서는 “상대를 음해하기 위해서 흑색선전을 하는 행위, 금품을 살포해서 선거 질서를 어지럽히고 표를 매수하는 행위, 공직자들의 선거 개입 행위 등 범죄들에 대해서는 아주 과감하게 신속하게 엄정하게 대응하기 바란다”고 했다.)

He then said, "There must never be any acts like spreading fake news to distort the opinions and will of the people, obstructing decision-making, bribing with money, intervening with power, or manipulating and distorting processes," adding, "Ensuring that voters can freely collect information about elections and candidates and make rational decisions based on that information is the government's greatest responsibility." <<>> (이어 “국민들의 의견, 의사를 왜곡하기 위해서 가짜 정보를 유포한다든지 또는 의사결정을 방해한다든지 돈으로 매수한다든지 권력을 가지고 개입을 한다든지 조정 조작을 한다든지 이런 일이 절대 있어서는 안 된다”라며 “그래서 선거인들이 자유롭게 선거에 관한, 후보에 관한 정보를 수집하고 정보에 의해서 합리적인 판단을 할 수 있도록 하는 것은 정부의 가장 큰 책무”라고 했다.)

item.title: Opposition’s ‘Indictment Withdrawal Special Counsel’ Provision… Ruling Party “Citizens Don’t Really Know What Indictment Withdrawal Means” (野 ‘공소취소 특검’ 규정에…與 “시민들은 공소취소 뜻 잘 몰라”)
item.description:
Opposition’s ‘Indictment Withdrawal Special Counsel’ Provision… Ruling Party “Citizens Don’t Really Know What Indictment Withdrawal Means” (野 ‘공소취소 특검’ 규정에…與 “시민들은 공소취소 뜻 잘 몰라”)

Democratic Party lawmaker Park Sung-joon on the 6th, addressing the controversy over the ‘Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel Act,’ which allows for the withdrawal of charges in the case of President Lee Jae-myung, stated, “While the politically highly engaged know what indictment withdrawal means, 8 to 9 out of 10 citizens are unaware,” adding that “the People Power Party has made a significant strategic miscalculation ahead of the election.” This was a counter-response to criticism from the opposition, which had framed it as an ‘indictment withdrawal special counsel.’ Lawmaker Park serves as the ruling party’s secretary for the National Assembly’s Special Committee on the Parliamentary Investigation into the Manipulated Indictment. <<> Appearing on CBS Radio’s ‘Park Sung-tae’s News Show’ that day, Park said, “The most basic aspect of an election is its impact on people’s lives, but diving into these political and legal debates creates a framework that is difficult for citizens to grasp.” He added, “The concept of a manipulated indictment is simple. ‘If there was a manipulated indictment, we need a special counsel, right?’ It’s straightforward,” and noted, “When you say ‘indictment withdrawal,’ people wonder, ‘What on earth does that mean?’” <<> In response, fellow panelist Kim Jae-seop of the People Power Party said, “Even if citizens don’t know the legal details, they will accurately see the intent behind the special counsel law.” Cheon Ha-ram of the Reform Party added, “Arguing about the complexity of indictment withdrawal is meaningless. What’s simple is that ‘a special counsel appointed by President Lee Jae-myung could terminate the president’s trial.’” <<> Park had also said on Kim Eo-jun’s YouTube channel the previous day, “It’s a frame of ‘manipulated indictment, manipulated investigation’ versus ‘indictment withdrawal,’” and “From the public’s perspective, manipulated investigation and manipulated indictment are easy to understand. If you ask what indictment withdrawal is, no one knows.” He continued, “There is no citizen who knows the details of what indictment withdrawal entails. Taking it into legal territory makes it a cumbersome issue,” adding, “Simply saying ‘because there was a manipulated indictment and manipulated investigation, a special counsel is the answer’ is something citizens can accept.” (더불어민주당 박성준 의원은 6일 이재명 대통령 사건을 공소 취소할 수 있게 한 ‘조작 기소 특검법’ 논란과 관련해 “공소 취소의 뜻을 정치 고관여층은 아는데, 시민들 10명 중 8~9명은 잘 모른다”며 “국민의힘이 선거 전략을 상당히 잘못 선택한 것”이라고 했다. 야권에서 ‘공소 취소 특검’이라고 규정하면서 비판하자 이에 맞대응한 것이다. 박 의원은 국회 조작기소 국정조사 특위 여당 간사를 맡았다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim Orders: "Discuss Whether to Retain the Right to Request Supplementary Investigations, Premised on Abolishing Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigation Authority" (金총리 “檢 보완수사권 폐지 전제로 보완수사요구권 남길지 논의하라” 지시)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim Orders: "Discuss Whether to Retain the Right to Request Supplementary Investigations, Premised on Abolishing Prosecutors' Supplementary Investigation Authority" (金총리 “檢 보완수사권 폐지 전제로 보완수사요구권 남길지 논의하라” 지시)

Regarding the issue of retaining supplementary investigation authority for the newly established Public Prosecution Service, which will replace the Prosecutor's Office in October, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok has instructed relevant agencies to "discuss the matter on the premise of abolishing the supplementary investigation authority." (오는 10월 검찰청을 폐지하고 신설되는 공소청에 보완 수사권을 남겨두는 문제와 관련해 김민석 국무총리가 관계 기구에 ‘보완 수사권 폐지를 전제로 논의하라’고 지시했다.)

According to a senior official at the Prime Minister's Office on the 6th, Prime Minister Kim recently ordered the Prime Minister's Office's Prosecution Reform Task Force to "set the direction toward abolishing prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority and discuss whether to grant the right to request supplementary investigations." The task force has been preparing amendments to the Criminal Procedure Act to define the powers of prosecutors in the Public Prosecution Service. (6일 총리실 관계자에 따르면, 김 총리는 최근 총리실 검찰개혁추진단에 “검사의 보완 수사권은 폐지하는 것으로 방향을 잡고, 보완 수사 요구권 부여 여부를 논의하라”고 지시했다. 검찰개혁추진단은 공소청 검사의 권한을 정하는 형사소송법 개정안을 준비해 왔다.)

The government had previously maintained a stance that prosecutors' supplementary investigation authority should be eliminated as much as possible, but discussions should also allow for exceptions. In a New Year's press conference on January 21, President Lee Jae-myung stated, "I believe prosecutors should not conduct supplementary investigations," but added, "There are exceptional cases where it is necessary." President Lee said, "If a case is transferred to the prosecution with only two days left before the statute of limitations expires, and there is something simple to verify, but supplementary investigations are completely banned, sending it back to the police and waiting for its return would take the full two days. Allowing such instances after blocking the possibility of abuse and creating safeguards would be a reform that handles state affairs efficiently." Prime Minister Kim also remarked at a press briefing on February 2, "I think the principle is not to have supplementary investigation authority, but the reality is that some people believe it is necessary," adding, "We need thorough debate on the pros and cons." (정부는 그동안 검사의 보완 수사권은 가급적 없애되, 예외적인 경우에는 허용하는 방안도 논의해야 한다는 입장이었다. 이재명 대통령은 지난 1월 21일 신년 기자회견에서 “(검사가) 보완 수사를 안 하는 게 맞다고 생각한다”면서도 “예외적으로 필요한 경우가 있다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 “공소시효가 이틀밖에 안 남았는데 (경찰에서 검찰로 사건이) 송치됐을 때, 간단히 확인할 게 있어도 보완 수사가 전면 금지돼 있으면 (사건을) 다시 경찰로 보내고 돌아오는 데 이틀이 끝나 버린다”며 “남용 가능성을 봉쇄하고 안전장치를 만든 다음에 그런 것 정도는 허용해 주는 게 국가 업무를 효율적으로 처리하는 개혁”이라고 했었다. 김 총리도 지난 2월 2일 기자 간담회에서 “보완 수사권은 원칙적으로 없는 게 맞다고 생각하지만, 필요하다고 생각하는 분들이 있는 것도 현실”이라며 “충분히 찬반 토론을 해야 한다”고 했었다.)

In contrast, hardliners within the Democratic Party of Korea insist that "supplementary investigation authority is direct investigative authority" and argue that to uphold the principle of separating investigation from prosecution, prosecutors should not be allowed to retain supplementary investigation rights. (반면 더불어민주당 강경파는 ‘보완 수사권은 직접 수사권’이라며, 수사·기소 분리 원칙을 지키려면 검사에게 보완 수사권을 남겨둬서는 안 된다는 입장을 고수하고 있다.)

In this context, Prime Minister Kim's directive is interpreted as a shift in the government's position toward not allowing supplementary investigation authority even in exceptional cases. Prime Minister Kim has left room only for the issue of granting prosecutors the authority to request supplementary investigations from the police. (이런 상황에서 김 총리의 지시는 정부가 보완 수사권을 예외적으로도 허용하지 않는 쪽으로 방향을 선회한 것으로 풀이된다. 김 총리는 검사가 경찰에 보완 수사를 요구할 수 있는 권한을 주는 문제에 대해서만 여지를 뒀다.)

Political circles interpret this as an attempt by Prime Minister Kim to seize the initiative in discussions on prosecution reform, keeping in mind the upcoming race for party leadership within the Democratic Party after the June 3 local elections. (이를 두고 정치권에서는 김 총리가 6·3 지방선거 이후 펼쳐질 민주당 당권 경쟁을 염두에 두고 검찰 개혁 논의의 주도권을 가지려 한다는 해석이 나온다.)

The Prosecution Reform Task Force is holding a joint forum with the Democratic Party today to discuss measures for so-called "prosecution reform," including the right for prosecutors to request supplementary investigations. (검찰개혁추진단은 이날 검사 보완 수사 요구권 등 이른바 ‘검찰 개혁’ 방안에 대해 민주당과 함께 공동 토론회를 연다.)

item.title: Trump says "Iran fired"… Pressures South Korea to join operation (트럼프 “이란이 쐈다”… 한국에 작전 참여 압박)
item.description:
Trump says "Iran fired"… Pressures South Korea to join operation (트럼프 “이란이 쐈다”… 한국에 작전 참여 압박)

Following an explosion and fire on a South Korean vessel in the Strait of Hormuz on the 4th, the Donald Trump administration is strongly pressuring South Korea to participate in the US-led 'Project Freedom,' which supports the transit of ships through the strait. <<> During a regular briefing on the 5th, US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth responded to a reporter's question about whether the US could share information regarding the South Korean ship reported to have been struck by Iran, saying, "We are maintaining contact with that vessel, and CENTCOM and maritime authorities are in communication." He added, "We hope South Korea will step up (to Project Freedom). We have the same expectations for Japan, Australia, and Europe." He also noted, "The President made it clear: 'These are your ships, so you must participate in their defense.'" <<> This reiterates President Trump's earlier social media post from the previous day, in which he wrote, "Iran has fired several times at non-belligerent countries, including a South Korean cargo ship," and suggested, "It may be time for South Korea to come and join the mission." This marks a situation where both the US President and Defense Secretary are successively pressuring South Korea to participate in response to the distress of a South Korean ship. The US had previously requested the deployment of a South Korean naval vessel back in March. <<> 'Project Freedom,' which began on the 4th, is a military operation aimed at supporting civilian vessels trapped in the Persian Gulf to pass through the Strait of Hormuz. While it does not directly escort individual ships, it is expected to operate by providing information on mine-free routes and using naval ships and aircraft to deter potential attacks from Iran. <<> Cheong Wa Dae stated on the 5th, "The government maintains the position that the safety of international maritime routes and freedom of navigation are principles that must be protected under international law," and added, "In this context, we are also taking note of President Trump's remarks." It further noted, "We are reviewing the US proposal while taking into account our readiness posture on the Korean Peninsula and domestic legal procedures." Our Ministry of National Defense also announced, "We will carefully review our position, considering international law, the safety of international maritime routes, the ROK-US alliance and security situation on the Korean Peninsula, and domestic legal procedures." (지난 4일 호르무즈 해협 내 한국 선박에서 폭발·화재가 발생한 것을 계기로, 도널드 트럼프 미국 행정부가 선박들의 해협 통항을 지원하는 미국 주도 ‘프로젝트 프리덤’에 한국이 참여할 것을 강도 높게 압박하고 나섰다.)
